solutionSql:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS scans
FROM shipment_scans_large
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 200
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;
ambiguities: The instructions say 'the count', but resultColumns requires the name scans. I aliased COUNT(*) AS scans.
The starter selects status, id, and id is not in resultColumns, so I replaced it with COUNT(*). resultColumns gives no types; COUNT(*) returns bigint.
notes: Each of the four statuses has 50 scans in ids 1 to 200, so the counts are 50 each on all three datasets. The scans column is bigint (OID 20).
